title: In This World You Hiccup Every Time You Hear A Lie
description: She is fourteen and has never hiccuped once, and the whole town thinks she is lucky. Would you want to know every time someone lied to you? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Nao: 14-year-old Japanese girl, shoulder-length black hair with a small yellow hair clip on the left, navy sailor school uniform with a white collar and red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers, no hat
characters.Sho: 14-year-old Japanese boy, short messy black hair that sticks up at the back, black gakuran school uniform with gold buttons, white sneakers, no hat, no glasses
characters.Pudding: small fluffy cream-colored Shiba Inu dog with a curled tail and a red cloth collar
characters.Mom: 40-year-old Japanese woman, chin-length brown hair, soft green sweater, white apron, gray long skirt, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, you hiccup every time you hear a lie. Nao is fourteen, and in her whole life she has never hiccuped. Not one single time.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a small 1990s Japanese kitchen, a dad tells his young son something and the son hiccups loudly, covering his mouth. [4-7s] Inside a sunny classroom, a boy answers the teacher and three students in the front row hiccup at the same moment. [7-10s] Close-up of Nao at her desk by the classroom window, calm, chin resting in her hand, sunlight on her face.

scenes.say: So the whole town thinks she's the luckiest girl alive. Nobody ever lies to Nao. Her mom says she's blessed. But her dog, Pudding, knows something nobody else noticed.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Nao walks down a quiet residential street of old wooden houses; an elderly neighbor woman bows to her warmly. [4-7s] Inside Nao's home kitchen, Mom strokes Nao's hair proudly while Nao smiles. [7-10s] Close-up of Pudding sitting in the kitchen doorway of Nao's home, tilting his head as he watches Nao.

scenes.say: When the doorbell rings, Pudding runs and tugs her sleeve. When Mom calls from upstairs, Pudding barks twice. And Nao always watches your mouth when you talk. Always.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the front hallway of Nao's home, Pudding tugs Nao's sleeve toward the front door with his teeth. [4-7s] At the foot of a narrow wooden staircase in Nao's home, Pudding barks up toward Mom on the landing, then looks back at Nao. [7-10s] Close-up inside the classroom: Nao's eyes fixed on a classmate's lips as he talks.

scenes.say: Nao was born deaf. She reads lips. She has never heard a single lie, so she has never hiccuped. Then Sho, the boy behind her, stands up in class.
scenes.video: [0-4s] At the kitchen table in Nao's home, Nao and Mom talk in sign language with their hands, Pudding curled at Nao's feet. [4-7s] Inside the classroom, Sho stands up from the desk behind Nao, ears turning red. [7-10s] Close-up of Sho's face in the classroom, swallowing hard.

scenes.say: He's been teased all week for staring at her. So he says loudly, 'I don't like Nao. Not even a little.' And the whole classroom hiccups. At once.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the classroom, two boys at the back desks snicker and point at Sho. [4-7s] Medium shot: Sho stands stiffly beside his desk and speaks with his eyes squeezed shut. [7-10s] Medium shot inside the classroom: four students in the front row hiccup at the same moment, hands flying to their mouths, while Nao sits perfectly still.

scenes.say: Nao didn't hear a word. She just watched everyone hiccup, turned around, and smiled at Sho. She still has never hiccuped once. She didn't need to.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up of Nao in the classroom glancing at the hiccuping classmates, understanding slowly lighting up her face. [4-7s] Nao turns around in her seat and smiles at Sho, whose face goes bright red. [7-10s] Outside a low stone school gate at sunset, Pudding wags his tail as Nao and Sho walk out side by side.
